head: Tuning needed
a release.
So we stopped.
body: Every change needed a code review, a release, and a week of store rollout.
So we stopped tuning, which is the worst possible outcome.

head: A threshold is a
*hypothesis
slides.caption: Constants are for things that cannot change, like the number of metres in a kilometre. A jitter threshold is a current best guess wearing a constant's clothes.

head: One config object,
not eighteen consts
body: Constants are for things that cannot change, like the number of metres in a kilometre. A jitter threshold is a current best guess wearing a constant's clothes.

items.title: Gather them into one object
items.sub: 18 scattered const val became one config

items.title: Make it serialisable
items.sub: now it can come from somewhere else

head: Separate the algorithm
from its
*parameters
body: A hypothesis needs to be cheap to revise. If tuning costs a release, people guess instead of measuring.
And then they defend the guess.
